Definition: to pull down or in pieces, break, destroy
BiblicalUsage: Haras means to pull down, to break to pieces, and it is used for enemies, for cities, and for foolish choices alike. In Exodus 15:7 God overthrows them that rise up against him, in Jeremiah 1:10 the prophet is set to root out and to pull down, in Proverbs 14:1 the foolish woman plucks down her house with her hands, and in Psalms 28:5 the wicked shall be destroyed and not built up.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe pulling down is God's work and mine to fear in equal measure: he pulls down what rises against him, and my own hands can pull down what I was meant to build. The wise woman builds; the foolish one breaks, and I want to know which one I am being.
